title: Activation and Access Terms for Dental and Vision Savings Memberships
content:
# Activation and Access Terms

The following terms govern when the discounts of a Dental and Vision Savings Membership become usable and what limits apply to their use. They are identical for all six memberships: Cascade Smile Savings Individual and Household, Cascade Smile & Sight Savings Individual and Household, and Cascade Smile & Sight Savings Plus Individual and Household.

1. **First payment.** A membership activates only after its first fee is paid in full.
2. **Activation period.** Discounts become usable 3 business days after the first fee payment.
3. **Waiting period.** The waiting period beyond activation is 0 days: none.
4. **Visit limit.** The number of discounted visits per year is 0, meaning unlimited.
5. **Existing conditions.** Conditions existing before enrollment are not excluded.

| Term | All six memberships |
|---|---|
| Activation requires the first fee paid in full | Yes |
| Business days after the first fee payment on which discounts become usable | 3 |
| Waiting period beyond activation (days) | 0 — none |
| Discounted visits per year | 0 — unlimited |
| Exclusion for conditions existing before enrollment | No exclusion |

## Points of judgement

- **First fee paid only in part.** The membership has not met the first-payment term; activation follows only payment in full.
- **Third business day after payment in full.** Discounts are usable from that day; no further waiting period runs after activation.
- **A condition that existed before enrollment.** Services for it receive the same discounts as any other service.
- **Many visits in one year.** There is no cap on the number of discounted visits.
